repository.name: @webex/plugin-attachment-actions
repository.purpose: Public plugin registered as webex.attachmentActions for the submit actions of adaptive cards attached to Webex messages, through the Webex REST API attachment/actions resource (catalog service hydra): create POSTs the caller's attachment action unchanged as a JSON body and get takes a record or id and resolves the record. listen() builds a webhook-style event envelope, connects the Mercury socket, and turns conversation activities with the verb cardAction into created events built from the activity alone, with Hydra attachment action, message, person, and room ids and the decrypted card inputs; a conversion error is logged and drops the event. Importing the package also registers the conversation and mercury internal plugins. Nothing is cached or persisted.

attachment-actions-public-sdk.summary: Published npm package (public plugin). main is dist/index.js and devMain is src/index.js; no type declarations are published. Importing it registers the conversation and mercury internal plugins and then AttachmentActions as public plugin 'attachmentActions' with no config; the first registration of the name wins. The entry exports only the default AttachmentActions class. webex.attachmentActions exposes create, get, and listen, triggers the created event, and carries the JSDoc-private onWebexApiEvent and getattachmentActionEvent; specified in src/docs/README.md.

hydra-attachment-actions-http.source: Webex REST API attachment actions resource (catalog service name hydra, reached through service: 'hydra' in src/attachmentActions.js; route definitions are not in this repository)
hydra-attachment-actions-http.summary: POST /attachment/actions with the caller's JSON body (type, messageId, inputs) answering the created record; GET /attachment/actions/<id> answering the record. Attachment action ids are base64url of ciscospark://<cluster>/ATTACHMENT_ACTION/<uuid>.

webex-core-plugin-host.summary: registerPlugin keys a public plugin by its raw name (attachmentActions, first registration wins) and adds webex.<name> to later instances; WebexPlugin supplies webex, request, logger, and the ampersand event methods on, off, trigger, listenTo, and stopListening.

webex-core-services.summary: getClusterId(url) returns the catalog cluster id of a URL, which getHydraClusterString in @webex/common turns into the cluster part of a Hydra id.

common-hydra-ids.source: @webex/common (workspace package; module spec consulted: packages/@webex/common/src/docs/README.md MOD-006, INV-001, INV-005; code consulted: packages/@webex/common/src/uuid-utils.js and constants.js)
common-hydra-ids.summary: constructHydraId(type, id, cluster) encodes base64url ciscospark://<cluster>/<TYPE>/<id>, PEOPLE always with cluster us; hydraTypes holds ATTACHMENT_ACTION, MESSAGE, PEOPLE, and ROOM; getHydraClusterString maps the internal US clusters to us and throws below three cluster parts; SDK_EVENT holds the Mercury event name event:conversation.activity, the activity verb cardAction, the resource attachmentActions, and the external event name created.

common-event-envelope.source: @webex/common createEventEnvelope (module spec consulted: packages/@webex/common/src/docs/README.md MOD-011; code consulted: packages/@webex/common/src/event-envelope.js)
common-event-envelope.summary: createEventEnvelope(webex, resource) fetches webex.people.get('me') once per instance and resolves {createdBy, orgId, resource, ownedBy: creator, status: active, created, data: {}}; when the identity lookup fails it resolves undefined instead of rejecting.

conversation-activity-decryption.source: @webex/internal-plugin-conversation (workspace package; no module spec exists; code consulted: packages/@webex/internal-plugin-conversation/src/index.js and src/decryption-transforms.js)
conversation-activity-decryption.summary: Importing the package registers internal plugin conversation with payload-transformer predicates, one of which transforms (decrypts) every inbound event that has an activity; decryptSubmit decrypts object.inputs of a submit object and, on failure, logs a warning and sets inputs to the configured decryptionFailureMessage string. This package calls no conversation method.

mercury-activity-events.source: @webex/internal-plugin-mercury (workspace package; module spec consulted: packages/@webex/internal-plugin-mercury/src/docs/README.md MOD-001, MOD-002, MOD-009, stale on sessions; code consulted: packages/@webex/internal-plugin-mercury/src/mercury.js)
mercury-activity-events.summary: Importing the package registers internal plugin mercury. connect() shares a connect in flight and resolves at once when connected; an inbound envelope with event type conversation.activity is emitted as event:conversation.activity with data.activity; a listener error is caught and logged by _emit.
